Hostname oder IP-Adresse der VictoriaMet: Hostname or IP address of the VictoriaMetrics instance, without protocol
Wie oft gepufferte Werte gesammelt an Vi: How often buffered values are sent to VictoriaMetrics in a batch
Löst bei Erreichen einen sofortigen Schr: Triggers an immediate write when reached, independent of the write interval
Überschreibt die automatisch aus der Obj: Overrides the metric name (__name__) automatically derived from the object ID. Leave empty for the default derivation.
Rundet den Wert vor dem Schreiben auf di: Rounds the value to the given number of decimal places before writing. Leave empty for no rounding.
Werte, die sich vom zuletzt geschriebene: Values that differ from the last written value by less than this amount are not written. Leave empty for no filtering.
Protokolliert den Wert erst, wenn er für: Only logs the value once it has stayed unchanged for the given time. Leave empty to write immediately.
Ignoriert neue Werte für die angegebene: Ignores new values for the given time after the last written value.
Gelten für alle Datenpunkte, die im Hist: Apply to all datapoints that don't set their own value in the Historie tab.
Schreibt einen Wert nur, wenn er sich vo: Only writes a value if it differs from the last written value.
Schreibt einen unveränderten Wert spätes: Writes an unchanged value again at the latest after this time, so charts don't show gaps. Only effective when 'Log changes only' is enabled.
docker_explanation: The adapter can run its own VictoriaMetrics server in a Docker container. Docker must be installed on this host and the ioBroker user must be allowed to use it. The container is created and started automatically; the connection settings are then applied by the adapter itself and hidden here.
127.0.0.1 = nur auf diesem Rechner errei: 127.0.0.1 = reachable on this host only. Change it to 0.0.0.0 or another IP only in trusted networks: VictoriaMetrics has no access restriction here.
Port, unter dem der Container auf diesem: The port on which the container will be reachable on this host
Zahl = Monate, oder mit Einheit h, d, w,: A number means months, or add a unit h, d, w, y (e.g. 12, 90d, 100y). Changing it re-creates the container; the data is kept.
Wenn aktiviert, wird beim Start des Adap: If enabled, the latest Docker image will be pulled when the adapter starts.
